village.notes: Old site vacated 1981-86; census Kheenyera 069262 survives outside the range. Annual Nathu Dada fair (mela) and night jagran held at Khiyana Dham inside the range; villagers admitted once a year (Shubh Journey vlog, Sep 2024).
